propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets whose relation graph walks through the broken directory.
Empty directories in .tickets-tracker persist across retries until manually removed and are invisible to git status, preventing detection and propagation in shared history.
The reducer error names the broken ticket, not the ticket being reviewed, creating a misleading wrong-direction signal for debugging unrelated plan review failures.
The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the entire snapshot, allowing reviews to proceed on unrelated tickets.

The writer creates ticket directories via os.makedirs before writing events; process death during the staging window leaves orphan event-less directories that cannot be repaired by git pull or fixed by writer-side cleanup due to concurrency constraints.
